verdict.rationale: Qodo supports managing its review configuration "as code" via a .pr_agent.toml file at repo/org level, which implies git-based versioning and rollback of automation settings, and offers org vs repo-level overrides in the portal. However, there is no explicit documented version-history UI or one-click rollback feature for automations/configurations themselves. Missing for 10: dedicated version history/audit trail for config changes, explicit rollback mechanism beyond inferred git revert, and any review workflow specifically for undoing automation changes.
